method.source: Wikimedia Pageviews (holiday spike) + Datamuse word frequency (commonness) + Wikidata aliases
method.window: December 2023-2025 vs. each year's typical month (median Feb-Oct)
method.note: Points = share of a 100-person 'survey' from commonness in everyday English x the December spike in Wikipedia lookups (common AND seasonal).
